hooks.text: 不同卡牌组合会召唤不同魔晶武器，角色技能也随流程逐步解锁。
hooks.excerpt: You can summon different Magical Crystals (weapons) for battle by forming different card combinations! Characters also have awesome skills waiting for you to unlock!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 古物可改写卡牌，魔宠既会助战也可能捣乱，两者共同组成拥有数百遗物组合的牌组。
hooks.excerpt: Use Antiquities to alter your cards and summon even more powerful Magical Crystals (weapons)! Familiars are here to assist streamers in battle, but watch out—they might just stir up some trouble too!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 魔界主播姐妹在直播战斗中拯救疯狂粉丝，并通过动画章节调查网络崩溃、走向多结局。
hooks.excerpt: Now, wielding these magical cards, they must battle through live streams to save their frenzied fans and fellow demons! As they investigate the network chaos, they begin to uncover shocking truths about their world...
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
